caveats_for_integrator: OWNED (confusion-geometry, sec:confusion): 'the boundaries are properties of the stimuli, not of any one model' -- supported only by 3 frontier models agreeing + small models not; 'properties of the stimuli' is a universal from a cross-vendor n=3.

OWNED (confusion-geometry, sec:confusion): 'First, it validates the hard-negative family design of the option menu' -- circular as stated: the d=1 concentration is measured with the same hand-designed families that built the hard negatives; should be reconciled with the independent-distance re-analysis (GED/equation-distance tasks).

OWNED (errors-live, sec:geometry): 'DINOv2 perceptual similarity does not (beta=+0.23, n.s.)' -- point estimate is positive and non-trivial; 'does not predict' is stronger than a non-significant test on 25 motifs supports; suggest 'is not a significant predictor'. The closing 'misreads an idea' flourish rests on this null.

OWNED (voice-gradient, sec:voice-gradient): 'the ordering ... is the same' for all three frontier models -- adjacent rungs differ by a few items on 25-item tasks; per-model ordering is observed but CIs on adjacent-rung differences overlap; abstract item (i) 'consistent voice gradient' inherits this.

SHARED FRAMING: the word 'lawful' (abstract, contribution 4, results intro, conclusion) and abstract item (ii) 'conceptual space, not pixel space' inherit from the owned subsections; if the independent-distance re-analysis weakens Mantel r=0.36 / family beta=+0.42, these four sites need coordinated softening -- flagged, not edited.
